bug_semantics: A script-controlled integer zero reaches Boxed_Number::go in the assign_remainder arm. The vulnerable arm executes *t_lhs %= c_rhs without check_divide_by_zero(c_rhs), so integer remainder assignment by zero raises SIGFPE and can terminate the embedding process rather than raising ChaiScript's arithmetic error.
flaw_origin: Commit dd918c524d0bc9d081df723f42e18874874e4cf7 replaced the guarded binary_int_go assign_remainder implementation with a newly written unguarded *t_lhs %= c_rhs arm during an if-constexpr dispatch rewrite. The direct parent 8568b61014e9ede0afb24d064aefba3204836106 called check_divide_by_zero(u) immediately before t %= u. The later 9bbe7238278f96141b51ab4c6e5313ffc2879bea repair left assign_remainder unguarded by placing the intended check in assign_bitwise_and, so it did not supersede the original BIC.
